fundraiserlandingpage-desc: Waxay qaadataa xuduudaha URL-ka waxayna u gudbisaa tusmada la cayimay sidii doorsoomayaal tusmada.
fundraiserlandingpage-meta-description: Ku deeq Wikimedia Foundation, oo ah ururka aan faa’iido doonka ahayn ee martigeliya Wikipedia iyo mashruucyada kale ee aqoonta bilaashka ah ee muhiimka ah. Sannad kasta, deeqsinimada 2% ee akhristayaasha wax ku deeqa waxay noo oggolaanaysaa inaan ballaarino gaadhitaanka Wikipedia iyo mashruucyadeenna kale. Hadafkeenna waa inaan hubinno in aqoontu ay sii ahaato mid si bilaash ah loo heli karo jiilasha soo socda, taasna waxaan u baahan nahay taageeradaada.
